missing_cuts_and_forms: No guidelines for dried bean curd skin (yuba) rehydration, wrapping, or simmering.
No cooking parameters for pressed spiced dry tofu (doufugan) or five-spice tofu cakes.
No specifications for tofu puffs (fried tofu pouches) or aburaage simmering times.
No fermented or stinky tofu preparation methods.
missing_methods: No direct outdoor grilling parameters or stick-prevention grate seasoning rules for extra-firm tofu slabs.
No liquid-to-tofu ratios or simmering times for spicy braised tofu (e.g. Mapo Tofu).
No oven sheet-pan roasting time/temperature curves across convection vs conventional ovens.
No deep-poaching or gentle broth simmer parameters.
missing_parameters: No quantitative formula for pressing weight (exact weight in pounds or optimal duration beyond '15 to 20 minutes').
No measured marinade absorption rates (oil-based vs water/soy-based marinades) for pressed versus unpressed tofu blocks.

app_recommendations: Commercial pasteurized tofu requires no minimum internal cooking kill temperature; configure the app engine to permit raw/chilled consumption (e.g., silken tofu with soy dressing) or heating to 165°F (73.9°C) for warm dishes/leftovers.
Enforce a mandatory 15-minute pressing step for firm and extra-firm tofu in all sauté, sear, and air-fry workflows to expel internal moisture and guarantee a crisp exterior.
Recommend a light cornstarch dusting before searing or air-frying to achieve a shatter-crisp crust without deep-frying.
Treat silken tofu with strict gentle-handling logic: no vigorous stirring, add at the end of hot preparations, or serve cold/steamed with dressing.
